intro.text: A Rosharan tree whose sap, mixed with lavis seeds, is spread over the hills in the seasons after the Weeping.
A Rosharan tree whose long, banner-like leaves sprout only on the trunk's leeward side, away from the storms, and whip audibly as they fold. Its sap is mixed with lavis seeds for sowing.

description.text: In places such as Kholinar, stumpweights are grown much taller and leafier than usual to give more shade.
Stumpweights have thick, knobby trunks and tend to grow in small clusters.
Shallan is puzzled when she comes across a stumpweight trunk deep in the central Shattered Plains chasms, where it is too cold for the trees to grow.
Stumpweight timber is heavy, durable and dark. It is used for doors and for furniture such as chairs and desks, and can be polished for decoration.
Stumpweight sap can also be used as an emulsifier when mixing oil and water.
